newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Usmania Glass to offer rights share.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Usmania Glass to offer rights share.

text.p: Bangladesh's Usmania Glass Sheet Factory Ltd is issuing rights shares worth 70 million taka to finance its 380 million modernisation and expansion programme, company officials said on Thursday.
The company is also expected to announce a 25 percent dividend on its 100-taka share at an annual general meeting on Friday.
The officials said the company would offer one rights share against each share held by the investors at 500 taka, including a premium of 400 taka.
The company, 51 percent owned by the government, had already completed the expansion which helped it raise annual production by 13 percent in 1995/96.
Mohammad Masudur Rahman, the chairman of the company, said the company's profit rose nearly 29 percent to 21.4 million in 1995/96 following the modernisation of the plant in 1995.
